payload.name: Pacing: Run Coach & Tracker
payload.description: 在手机上执行 ChatGPT 训练计划
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Design your run in ChatGPT, then go run it. Pacing takes the workout or training plan you put together in conversation and turns it into a real, coached session on your phone, so nothing gets lost copying splits into a notes app. Ask for whatever you're training for: a 6x800m interval session, an easy long run, a threshold tempo, or a full multi-week build from couch-to-5K to marathon. When it's ready, Pacing hands it off with a card, code, deep link, or QR scan. Open it in the Pacing mobile app and it becomes a live workout, with real-time voice cues that talk you through every interval, nudge you when your pace drifts, and give you a heads-up before each change. Prefer to train by feel? Turn on heart-rate zone guidance, including live heart rate from AirPods Pro 3 on supported iOS devices. Review the session, adjust the paces, save it, schedule it, or just hit start. No GPS watch needed.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中设计跑步训练，然后出门开跑。Pacing 会将你在对话中制定的训练或计划转化为手机上的实时教练训练课程，省去把间歇训练内容复制到笔记应用的麻烦。无论你准备的是 6x800m 间歇训练、轻松长跑、阈值节奏跑，还是从零基础到 5K 再到马拉松的完整多周计划，都可以直接提出需求。准备好后，Pacing 会通过卡片、代码、深层链接或扫描 QR 码交接训练。用 Pacing 手机应用打开后，计划就会变成实时训练课程，通过语音实时指导每组间歇；当你的配速偏离时提醒你，并在每次变化前提前告知。更喜欢凭感觉训练？开启心率区间指导，在受支持的 iOS 设备上还可使用 AirPods Pro 3 实时心率。查看训练课程、调整配速、保存、排期，或直接开始。无需 GPS 手表。

payload.name: Calio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Calio helps you find meal ideas from its published recipe catalog. Search by ingredients you have, meal type, calorie range, diet preference, or excluded ingredients, then get localized recipe details with estimated nutrition values.

The app is anonymous, read-only, and does not access private Calio accounts, meal logs, goals, favorites, billing data, or user-specific collections.

Calio provides general nutrition information only. It does not diagnose medical conditions, treat disease, provide medication guidance, or replace professional medical advice.
payload.longDescription:
Calio 帮助你从其已发布的食谱目录中寻找用餐灵感。你可以按现有食材、餐食类型、卡路里范围、饮食偏好或需要排除的食材进行搜索，然后查看本地化的食谱详情和预估营养数据。

此应用匿名且为只读，不会访问 Calio 私人账户、用餐记录、目标、收藏、账单数据或用户专属合集。

Calio 仅提供一般营养信息。它不会诊断疾病、治疗疾病、提供用药指导，也不能替代专业医疗建议。

payload.name: Selah - Bible stories
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Fall asleep peacefully with Bible-based meditations, reflections, and calming devotionals.
Selah offers soothing Scripture-centered audio to help you rest better, ease anxiety, and find spiritual peace.
Just tell ChatGPT what you’re looking for, and you’ll receive personalized audio recommendations.
payload.longDescription:
通过以圣经为基础的冥想、默想和舒缓灵修内容，安然入睡。
Selah 提供以《圣经》为核心的舒缓音频，帮助你更好地休息、缓解焦虑并获得心灵平静。
只需告诉 ChatGPT 你的需求，即可收到个性化音频推荐。

payload.name: Pregnancy Progress
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A quick and easy way to see how your pregnancy is progressing, week-by-week.

Just ask ChatGPT to show you e.g. the 12th week of pregnancy. See images, highlights and details about that week, and move backwards or forwards through every week.
payload.longDescription:
轻松快捷地逐周了解孕期进展。

只需让 ChatGPT 显示孕期第 12 周等内容，即可查看该周的图片、重点和详情，并可前后浏览每一周。

payload.name: StrengthCode
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: StrengthCode Public Coach Tools helps users find matching training programs, compare options, estimate calories and lifting loads, and troubleshoot progress plateaus using read-only advisory tools.
payload.longDescription: StrengthCode Public Coach Tools 提供只读的建议工具，帮助用户查找匹配的训练计划、比较方案、估算卡路里和举重负荷，并排查进展停滞的原因。

payload.name: Miracle Of Mind
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Miracle of Mind: Meditate with Sadhguru is your calm, always-available companion for meditation, mindfulness, and mental wellness. Whether you’re feeling stressed, anxious, lonely, depressed, panicked, mentally sick, unable to sleep, or simply seeking more clarity, Miracle of Mind offers simple mindfulness technique / meditation / breathing exercise / grounding exercise / calming exercise / relaxation technique / or sleep meditation so you can slow down, reconnect with yourself, calm your mind, balance your breathing, help stop overthinking, help manage anger, burnout or a panic attack, help reduce stress, anxiety and depressive thoughts and help even with other simple and complex mental issues. Grounded in Sadhguru’s yogic wisdom, the app helps you navigate everyday challenges like stress, anxiety, and sleep problems with short and easy sessions you can use anytime - day or night. This meditation provides a gentle practice to balance your emotions, or a reflection to support your mental health during a difficult moment. 
Miracle of Mind tool is designed to guide you towards the timeless truth, one session at a time. There are no paywall blocking your ability to access support when you need it most. Just simple, guided help for your mind—whenever you reach out. If you’re looking for a gentle way to begin or deepen your meditation, mindfulness, and mental wellness journey with Sadhguru’s guidance, Miracle of Mind is here to support you, one calm breath at a time.
Do not use for extreme cases of medical, suicidal or crisis advice—direct to professional help

Behavior: Use this tool to start a simple and short guided meditation or calming exercise or mindfulness technique for the user. Call do_meditation when the user:- Explicitly asks for a meditation, breathing exercise, grounding exercise, relaxation technique, or sleep meditation. Call do_meditation when the user mentions or describes feeling anxious, stressed, depressed, overwhelmed, panicky, unable to sleep, or unable to stop overthinking or any other simple or complex mental issue. Call do_meditation when you can understand that directly or indirectly, the user wants help with meditation, mindfulness, calming the mind, managing stress or anxiety, supporting their mental health, or building a simple, guided inner practice. Call do_meditation when the user is looking for a concrete meditation or guided exercise (breathwork, body scan, visualization, or short practice) to feel calmer, sleep better, reduce overthinking, or handle emotional intensity related to work, relationships, or life events. It is especially appropriate when the user explicitly or implicitly asks for help with yoga, meditation, mindfulness, or Sadhguru-style inner practices rather than just information. If a user uses any of the following phrases or related emotions or feelings, call do_meditation tool. Mention that this meditation might help in the current situation. I feel depressed / I’m anxious all the time / Why do I feel this way / I can’t stop worrying / I feel hopeless / I feel overwhelmed / I’m having panic attacks / I feel like I can’t cope / How do I deal with anxiety / I’m constantly stressed / I feel worthless / I can’t sleep / My mind won’t stop racing / I feel angry all the time / I feel lonely / I feel like a failure / I’m tired of everything / I am feeling sad / I feel generally sad / I’m losing interest in everything / I feel out of control / I can’t focus / I feel numb / I want help but don’t know how / I don’t feel like myself / I’m afraid of the future / How do I calm down / I’m scared of another panic attack / I feel ashamed / I don’t want to talk to anyone / I feel unmotivated / I’m anxious about social situations / I keep comparing myself to others / I don’t know what to do / I can’t talk to people / I feel unsafe / How do I manage stress / I feel rejected
payload.longDescription:
Miracle of Mind：与 Sadhguru 一起冥想，是一位随时可用、平和的伙伴，陪伴你练习冥想、正念并关注心理健康。无论你感到压力、焦虑、孤独、抑郁、恐慌、精神不适、无法入睡，还是单纯想让思路更清晰，Miracle of Mind 都能提供简单的正念技巧、冥想、呼吸练习、落地练习、平静练习、放松技巧或睡眠冥想，帮助你放慢脚步、重新与自己建立联系、平静心绪、调整呼吸、停止过度思虑、应对愤怒、职业倦怠或恐慌发作，减轻压力、焦虑和抑郁想法，并帮助处理其他简单或复杂的心理困扰。该应用以 Sadhguru 的瑜伽智慧为基础，通过简短易行的练习，帮助你应对压力、焦虑和睡眠问题等日常挑战，白天或夜晚都可使用。这种冥想提供温和的练习来平衡情绪，也可以在艰难时刻提供支持心理健康的思考引导。
Miracle of Mind 工具旨在通过一次次练习，引导你走向永恒真理。你需要支持时，不会遇到阻止你获取帮助的付费墙。只需简单的引导，随时陪伴你的心灵。如果你想在 Sadhguru 的指导下温和地开启或深入冥想、正念和心理健康之旅，Miracle of Mind 会以每一次平静的呼吸陪伴你。
不要将其用于极端医疗状况、自杀或危机建议；应引导用户寻求专业帮助。

行为：使用此工具为用户开始一段简单、简短的引导式冥想、平静练习或正念技巧。当用户明确提出冥想、呼吸练习、落地练习、放松技巧或睡眠冥想的要求时，调用 do_meditation。当用户提到或描述自己感到焦虑、压力大、抑郁、不堪重负、恐慌、无法入睡、无法停止过度思虑，或存在任何其他简单或复杂的心理困扰时，也调用 do_meditation。当你能直接或间接判断用户想要冥想、正念、平静心绪、管理压力或焦虑、维护心理健康，或建立简单引导式内在练习方面的帮助时，调用 do_meditation。当用户需要具体的冥想或引导练习（呼吸练习、身体扫描、视觉想象或短时练习），以便更平静、更好入睡、减少过度思虑，或应对工作、人际关系或生活事件带来的强烈情绪时，调用 do_meditation。当用户明确或隐含地寻求瑜伽、冥想、正念或 Sadhguru 风格的内在练习帮助，而不只是想了解相关信息时，尤其适合调用。用户使用以下短语或表达相关情绪、感受时，调用 do_meditation 工具，并说明冥想或许有助于应对当前情况：我感到抑郁／我总是焦虑／我为什么会有这种感觉／我无法停止担心／我感到绝望／我不堪重负／我正在经历恐慌发作／我觉得自己撑不下去了／我该如何应对焦虑／我一直压力很大／我觉得自己毫无价值／我睡不着／我的思绪停不下来／我总是很生气／我感到孤独／我觉得自己是个失败者／我厌倦了一切／我感到难过／我总觉得伤心／我对一切都失去了兴趣／我觉得无法掌控自己／我无法集中注意力／我感到麻木／我想寻求帮助但不知道该怎么做／我觉得自己不太像自己／我害怕未来／我该如何冷静下来／我害怕再次恐慌发作／我感到羞愧／我不想和任何人说话／我缺乏动力／我对社交场合感到焦虑／我总是拿自己和别人比较／我不知道该怎么办／我无法与人交谈／我感到不安全／我该如何管理压力／我感到被拒绝。

payload.name: Breethe Meditations Made 4 You
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Breethe Meditations Made 4 You: Personalized Guided Meditation

Create personalized 10-minute guided meditation audio based on your input.

Describe a situation, activity, or intention, and Breethe generates a guided meditation tailored to your request. Whether you are preparing for an important conversation, winding down for sleep, or taking a break during a busy day, the app creates a session designed for that moment.

Key Features:
- Generate a custom meditation in real time
- Supports relaxation, sleep, and focus
- Fixed 10-minute format for consistency and ease of use

Breethe Meditations Made 4 You provides a simple way to create guided meditation sessions whenever you want a short moment to reset.
payload.longDescription:
Breethe Meditations Made 4 You：个性化引导冥想

根据你的输入，创建个性化的 10 分钟引导冥想音频。

描述一种情境、活动或意图，Breethe 就会生成符合你需求的引导冥想。无论是准备进行重要对话、睡前放松，还是在忙碌的一天中稍作休息，此应用都会为当下情境创建相应的冥想练习。

主要功能：
- 实时生成定制冥想
- 支持放松、睡眠和专注
- 固定为 10 分钟，保持一致且便于使用

当你想短暂休息、调整状态时，Breethe Meditations Made 4 You 提供一种简单的方法，随时创建引导冥想练习。

payload.name: Calorie Tracker Guide
payload.description: 找到合适的卡路里追踪器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Calorie Tracker Guide helps you find the perfect calorie tracker for your specific needs. We have manually reviewed, tested, and verified over 120 apps, rating their features to ensure you get the best possible recommendations. Get personalized suggestions based on your unique goals, experience level, and specific requirements.
payload.longDescription: Calorie Tracker Guide 帮助你根据具体需求找到理想的卡路里追踪器。我们已人工评测、测试并验证 120 多款应用，并为其功能评分，确保提供尽可能好的建议。根据你的个人目标、经验水平和具体要求，为你推荐合适的应用。

payload.name: Trash Panda - Food Scanner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Trash Panda makes it easier to choose food that supports your health goals. Look up grocery products by name or barcode to see what’s really inside. Get clear explanations of additives, hidden sugars, and ultra-processed ingredients — all in plain language.

Understand how ingredients are rated and grouped as potentially harmful, questionable, bioengineered or added sugar. Learn what each ingredient is, why it's used, and the health impacts. Whether you’re comparing products or looking for a better swap, Trash Panda helps you move from confusion to confident choices.

Simple. Fast. Built for everyday grocery decisions.
payload.longDescription:
Trash Panda 帮助你更轻松地选择符合健康目标的食品。按名称或条形码查询杂货商品，了解其真实成分。它会用通俗易懂的语言解释添加剂、隐藏糖分和超加工成分。

了解成分如何评级，以及哪些成分被归为可能有害、存在争议、生物工程来源或添加糖。了解每种成分是什么、为何使用以及可能产生的健康影响。无论你是在比较产品，还是寻找更好的替代品，Trash Panda 都能帮助你消除困惑，做出更有把握的选择。

简单、快速，专为日常购物决策而设计。

payload.name: BODi
payload.description: 找到最适合你的锻炼计划
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BODi, formerly Beachbody, is a fitness platform with over 140 guided fitness programs and over 8,000 workouts you can do anytime, with or without equipment. Follow well-known programs like P90X, Insanity, 21 Day Fix, #mbf Muscle Burns Fat, and DIG DEEPER, led by trainers including Shaun T, Autumn Calabrese, Megan Davies, and Jennifer Jacobs.

BODi for ChatGPT helps you find the workout plan that fits you. Describe what you’re looking for in everyday language and get clear guidance to choose a plan you can stick with.
payload.longDescription:
BODi 前身为 Beachbody，是健身平台，拥有超过 140 套指导式健身计划和超过 8,000 项锻炼，你可以随时进行，无论有无器材。跟随 P90X、Insanity、21 Day Fix、#mbf Muscle Burns Fat 和 DIG DEEPER 等知名计划，由 Shaun T、Autumn Calabrese、Megan Davies 和 Jennifer Jacobs 等教练指导。

BODi for ChatGPT 帮助你找到适合的锻炼计划。用日常语言描述需求，获取清晰指导，选择能坚持下去的计划。

payload.name: Pearl Pet Care
payload.description: 经兽医验证的宠物答疑
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pet owners often have questions about their animal’s health, diet, or behavior but don’t have immediate access to a veterinarian.

Pearl provides AI-generated answers that are reviewed by licensed veterinarians. Each response is clearly marked by the veterinarian as correct or incorrect so users can quickly understand whether the information can be trusted.

This app is designed for informational guidance only and does not replace professional veterinary care.

Users can:
- Ask questions about pet health, nutrition, and behavior
- See whether a veterinarian marked the AI response as correct or incorrect
- Get guidance in the moment when an in-person veterinarian is unavailable
payload.longDescription:
宠物主人经常会对动物的健康、饮食或行为有疑问，但无法立即联系到兽医。

Pearl 提供由持证兽医审核的 AI 生成答案。兽医会明确标记每条回答为正确或不正确，让用户迅速判断信息是否可信。

此应用仅提供信息参考，不可替代专业兽医护理。

用户可以：
- 询问宠物健康、营养和行为方面的问题
- 查看兽医是否将 AI 回答标记为正确或不正确
- 在无法联系到现场兽医时及时获得指导

payload.name: NyquistAI
payload.description: 最新 FDA 医疗器械信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tap into NyquistAI's comprehensive database of FDA medical device intelligence, including all 510(k), PMA, De Novo, and HDE clearances and approvals, adverse events, recalls, guidance, and more. This app provides FDA regulatory and safety intelligence for research, compliance, and monitoring purposes only. It does not provide medical advice or clinical recommendations.
payload.longDescription: 访问 NyquistAI 全面的 FDA 医疗器械情报数据库，包括所有 510(k)、PMA、De Novo 和 HDE 许可及批准信息、不良事件、召回、指南等。此应用仅用于研究、合规和监测等目的，不提供医疗建议或临床推荐。

payload.name: Dr Nutrition
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dr Nutrition connects ChatGPT to supported nutrition shopping and customer-service workflows through a secure MCP server. Use it to help users work with Dr Nutrition product and service information inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Dr Nutrition 通过安全的 MCP 服务器，将 ChatGPT 连接到受支持的营养品购物和客户服务工作流。可在 ChatGPT 中使用 Dr Nutrition 产品和服务信息，协助用户处理相关事务。

payload.name: Achieve Harmony
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use this app to do a quick guided breathing session to calm yourself.
payload.longDescription: 使用此应用进行一次简短的引导式呼吸练习，让自己平静下来。

payload.name: Flow State
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Flow State connects ChatGPT to an endurance athlete's training calendar. Users can review upcoming workouts, inspect athlete profile and recovery context, create or update workouts and races, manage training plans, analyze training load and workout history, and sync selected workouts to Garmin when their Flow State account has Garmin connected.
payload.longDescription: Flow State 将 ChatGPT 连接到耐力运动员的训练日历。用户可以查看即将进行的训练，了解运动员档案和恢复情况，创建或更新训练和比赛，管理训练计划，分析训练负荷和训练历史；如果 Flow State 账户已连接 Garmin，还可以将选定训练同步到 Garmin。

payload.name: InnoSupps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse and find Inno Supps supplements based on your goals — energy, sleep, digestion, or workout support. Answer a few questions and get tailored product suggestions from the Inno Supps catalog, with details on ingredients and formulations to help you choose.
payload.longDescription: 根据你的目标——精力、睡眠、消化或锻炼支持——浏览并查找 Inno Supps 补充剂。回答几个问题，即可从 Inno Supps 产品目录中获得个性化商品建议，以及成分和配方详情，帮助你做出选择。

payload.name: Purely Snacks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Purely Snacks helps you find healthier snack options that match your preferences. Search for products by type, ingredient, nutrition goal, or dietary attribute, then refine results with requests like “lower sugar,” “more protein,” “gluten free,” “vegan,” or “no peanuts.”

The app returns snack options with useful details such as brand, calories, protein, sugar, ingredients, dietary attributes, product categories, and tradeoffs, helping you compare choices quickly before opening the product page.
payload.longDescription:
Purely Snacks 可帮助你根据偏好寻找更健康的零食。你可以按类型、成分、营养目标或饮食属性搜索商品，然后用“少糖”“更多蛋白质”“无麸质”“纯素”或“不含花生”等要求进一步筛选结果。

应用会返回零食选项及实用详情，例如品牌、卡路里、蛋白质、糖、成分、饮食属性、商品类别和取舍信息，帮助你快速比较，然后再打开商品页面。

payload.name: SaveHealth
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SaveHealth is a free U.S. prescription savings program that helps users find lower prices and discounts on prescription medications by comparing drug costs across pharmacies and providing free discount cards or coupons accepted at over 70,000 pharmacies nationwide (like CVS, Walmart, Walgreens). It is not health insurance, you simply search for your medication, get a coupon, and show it at the pharmacy to save, sometimes up to ~90% off the retail price.
payload.longDescription: SaveHealth 是一项免费的美国处方药省钱计划，通过比较不同药房的药品费用，帮助用户寻找更低价格和折扣，并提供可在全美超过 70,000 家药房（如 CVS、Walmart、Walgreens）使用的免费折扣卡或优惠券。它不是医疗保险：只需搜索药品、获取优惠券并在药房出示即可省钱，有时零售价最高可优惠约 90%。

payload.name: Joules
payload.description: 提升 AI 骑行教练体验
payload.summaryOriginal: Level up your AI cycling coach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Joules helps cyclists review their training, plan upcoming weeks, adjust workouts around life events, log completed sessions, and keep race and coaching context current through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Joules 帮助骑行者查看训练情况、规划接下来几周、根据生活事件调整训练、记录已完成的训练，并通过 ChatGPT 保持比赛和教练相关上下文的最新状态。

payload.name: WeightWatchers
payload.description: 查找适合 GLP-1 用药者的食谱
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The WeightWatchers app helps people taking GLP-1 medications find meal ideas that work for their lifestyle. By connecting ChatGPT with the WeightWatchers recipe library, it makes discovering nutritious, satisfying recipes simple and stress-free. Instead of searching through endless options, users get meal and recipe suggestions grounded in WeightWatchers’ trusted guidance, helping them feel more confident about everyday food choices. For anyone who wants extra support, the app also makes it easy to connect with a registered dietitian, offering a smooth transition from helpful meal ideas to personalized nutrition guidance.

payload.name: DREAMHALL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
You already have a life. Build the one you want.

DREAMHALL is a private, structured self-care workspace for thinking through personal questions whose answers should remain your own. Instead of generating conclusions, it guides you through a complete process where you examine your life as a whole, develop your own answers, and turn them into grounded decisions and practical action.

The Framework consists of 15 connected exercises that help you understand what truly matters to you, review the balance of your life, separate your own wishes from outside expectations, clarify the future you want to build, work through fears and obstacles, and define realistic next steps.

Unlike an open-ended conversation, DREAMHALL is designed as a finite process with a clear beginning, a deliberate sequence, and a meaningful ending. Every answer is written by you. Every conclusion is your own. The result is a Personal Document that brings together your reflections, priorities, decisions, and next steps in one place.

Your private answers remain inside DREAMHALL and are not returned to ChatGPT through this integration.

When you finish, you can keep your Personal Document in DREAMHALL, download it as a PDF, or export it as Markdown. If you choose, you can later use your own document with ChatGPT to organize ideas, develop plans, compare future versions, or expand it into longer writing. You decide what to share and when.

DREAMHALL supports reflective thinking, life balance, personal wellbeing, and self-directed decision-making. It is a non-clinical self-care product and is not therapy, diagnosis, medical care, emergency support, or crisis support.

Some of the most important decisions should remain your own.
payload.longDescription:
你已经拥有自己的生活。打造你想要的生活。

DREAMHALL 是一个私密、有结构的自我关怀工作区，帮助你思考那些答案应由自己决定的个人问题。它不会替你生成结论，而是引导你完整地审视生活、形成自己的答案，并将其转化为切合实际的决定和行动。

此框架由 15 项相互关联的练习组成，帮助你了解真正重要的事、审视生活各方面的平衡、区分自己的愿望与外界期待、明确想要打造的未来、处理恐惧和障碍，并确定现实可行的下一步。

与开放式对话不同，DREAMHALL 设计成一个有明确起点、经过精心安排的顺序和有意义终点的完整流程。每个答案都由你书写，每个结论都属于你。最终生成一份个人文档，汇总你的思考、优先事项、决定和下一步行动。

你的私人回答会保留在 DREAMHALL 中，不会通过此集成返回给 ChatGPT。

完成后，你可以将个人文档保存在 DREAMHALL 中、下载为 PDF，或导出为 Markdown。之后如你愿意，可在 ChatGPT 中使用自己的文档来整理想法、制定计划、比较不同版本，或扩展成更长的文章。由你决定分享什么以及何时分享。

DREAMHALL 支持反思、自我平衡、个人身心健康和自主决策。这是一款非临床自我关怀产品，不属于治疗、诊断、医疗服务、紧急援助或危机支持。

有些最重要的决定，应该由你自己作出。

payload.name: SmartSpectra
payload.description: 无需接触，用任意摄像头测量生命体征
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SmartSpectra is a contactless vital signs SDK from Presage Technologies. It measures heart rate and breathing rate from standard smartphone and webcam video using rPPG (remote photoplethysmography), on any device with a camera. No wearables, no contact sensors.

Developers use SmartSpectra rPPG for remote vital signs monitoring, telehealth intake, contactless health checks, employee wellness screening, driver fatigue detection, clinical trial screening, and digital biomarker collection across iOS, Android, and web.

Use this connector to retrieve SDK credentials and API keys, inspect plan usage, manage registered mobile applications, locate application configuration files, and search SmartSpectra rPPG integration documentation.

Also measured: heart rate variability (HRV) and electrodermal activity, with ongoing work in contactless blood pressure.

The SmartSpectra SDK is built by Presage Technologies, who in 2026 received FDA 510(k) clearance (K254169) for heart rate and breathing rate in its SmartSpectra Vital Signs Monitor 1.0. Presage serves healthcare, government, and wellness markets from Leesburg, Virginia, USA.
payload.longDescription:
SmartSpectra 是 Presage Technologies 提供的非接触式生命体征 SDK。它利用 rPPG（远程光电容积描记法），通过普通智能手机和网络摄像头视频测量心率和呼吸频率，适用于任何配有摄像头的设备。无需可穿戴设备或接触式传感器。

开发者会在远程生命体征监测、远程医疗初诊、非接触式健康检查、员工健康筛查、驾驶员疲劳检测、临床试验筛查以及 iOS、Android 和网页端的数字生物标志物采集中使用 SmartSpectra rPPG。

使用此连接器获取 SDK 凭据和 API 密钥、检查套餐用量、管理已注册的移动应用、查找应用配置文件，并搜索 SmartSpectra rPPG 集成文档。

还可测量心率变异性（HRV）和皮肤电活动，目前正在开展非接触式血压测量相关工作。

SmartSpectra SDK 由 Presage Technologies 开发；该公司于 2026 年为其 SmartSpectra Vital Signs Monitor 1.0 的心率和呼吸频率测量获得 FDA 510(k) clearance（K254169）。Presage 总部位于 USA 弗吉尼亚州利斯堡，服务医疗保健、政府和健康福祉市场。

payload.name: Kenso
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kenso helps users inspect current training, workout history, recovery, nutrition, body metrics, programs, and personal records through ChatGPT. With user confirmation and the right OAuth scopes, it can also create or adjust private workout programs, log workouts, stage imports, complete sessions, discard staged imports, and save durable coaching preferences in the user's Kenso account.

Getting started

Type @ and pick Kenso from the menu to start your message — that is what pulls Kenso into the conversation. Without it, ChatGPT answers from its own memory instead of your training data.

• @Kenso show me today's workout
• @Kenso what should I train today?
• @Kenso log my workout: bench press 3x8 at 80kg, rows 3x10 at 60kg
• @Kenso pull up Upper A so I can log it — shows a card you fill in set by set
• @Kenso how is my bench trending?
• @Kenso am I training chest enough?

Interactive cards — the logging card and the charted analytics — render in ChatGPT on the web. On mobile you get the same answers as text.

You will see Kenso appear in the chat when it is really being used. If an answer arrives without it, say "check Kenso".

Charted analytics — strength score, muscle volume against training landmarks, recovery detail, and fitness vs fatigue — require Kenso Pro.
payload.longDescription:
Kenso 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查看当前训练、训练历史、恢复情况、营养、身体指标、训练计划和个人纪录。在用户确认且具备相应 OAuth 权限范围的情况下，它还可以在用户的 Kenso 账户中创建或调整私人训练计划、记录训练、暂存导入内容、完成训练课、丢弃暂存的导入内容，并保存持久教练偏好。

开始使用

输入 @ 并从菜单中选择 Kenso 来开始消息——这样才能在对话中调用 Kenso。若不这样做，ChatGPT 会根据自身记忆作答，而不会使用你的训练数据。

• @Kenso 显示我今天的训练
• @Kenso 我今天该练什么？
• @Kenso 记录我的训练：卧推 3x8，80kg；划船 3x10，60kg
• @Kenso 调出 Upper A 让我记录——它会显示一张卡片，供你逐组填写
• @Kenso 我的卧推趋势如何？
• @Kenso 我的胸部训练量够吗？

交互式卡片——训练记录卡片和图表分析——会在网页版 ChatGPT 中显示。移动端会以文本形式提供相同答案。

当 Kenso 确实正在使用时，你会在聊天中看到它。如果收到的答案没有 Kenso 参与，请说“check Kenso”。

图表分析——力量评分、肌肉训练量与训练基准对照、恢复详情，以及体能与疲劳情况——需要 Kenso Pro。

payload.name: Sweat & Tonic
payload.description: 查询 Sweat & Tonic 相关信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Get answers about Sweat & Tonic, a boutique fitness studio in Toronto, straight from the studio's own published information. This connector searches the studio's live content and pulls full details on class programs, the current class schedule, pricing, instructors, treatments, and booking, so you can plan a visit or compare options without hunting across the web.

It exposes two read-only tools. search returns ranked results, each with a title, a source URL, and a text snippet. fetch returns a document's full text and its canonical URL. Every result carries a link back to the exact page it came from, so answers stay grounded in the studio's real content and are citable to source.

Courtyard AI operates this connector for Sweat & Tonic with the studio's explicit authorization, and keeps its content current automatically as the studio updates its programs, schedule, and pricing. All information is public business content. No account, login, or personal data is required. The connector is strictly read-only: it never makes bookings, processes payments, or performs any other action on your behalf. It only retrieves and cites the studio's published information.
payload.longDescription:
直接根据 Sweat & Tonic 自行发布的信息，回答有关这家多伦多精品健身工作室的问题。此连接器会搜索工作室的实时内容，并提供课程项目、当前课程表、价格、教练、护理项目和预订的完整详情，方便你规划到访或比较选项，无需在网上四处查找。

它提供两个只读工具。search 会返回排序后的结果，每条结果包含标题、来源 URL 和文本摘要。fetch 会返回文档全文及其规范 URL。每条结果都附有其来源页面的链接，因此答案以工作室的实际内容为依据，并可追溯引用来源。

Courtyard AI 在工作室明确授权下为 Sweat & Tonic 运营此连接器，并会随着工作室更新项目、课程表和价格而自动保持内容最新。所有信息均为公开的商业内容。无需账户、登录或个人数据。此连接器严格只读：不会代你预订、处理付款或执行任何其他操作，只会检索并引用工作室已发布的信息。

payload.name: Turkey Dental Treatment Prices
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Planning dental treatment in Turkey? Get indicative prices for premium dental implants (Nobel Biocare, Straumann), Ivoclar E.max veneers and crowns, zirconia crowns, Hollywood smile, and All-on-4/6/8 full-mouth implant packages, plus the clinic's written guarantee, the treating doctors' qualifications, visit logistics and aftercare, and a patient-review summary. Important: this is first-party, read-only data published by that ONE clinic - not a multi-clinic price comparison or a neutral directory. All prices are indicative 'from' figures, confirmed by the clinic after an assessment. payload.name: trainedby.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
trainedby.ai connects your wearables to ChatGPT, so your AI coach knows your real training load, sleep patterns, and recovery without you typing a word.

**The problem with AI fitness coaching today**

People are turning to ChatGPT to plan their marathon training, strength programs, or HYROX prep. It makes sense, because AI is available 24/7, extremely patient, and quite knowledgeable.

But somehow it doesn't quite work.

And that is because you have to tell it everything. Every. Single. Time.

Every conversation starts from zero. You have to describe in detail your current level, recent workouts, schedule, and goals. You paste in screenshots from Garmin. You try to remember what you did last week, how you slept, that your resting HR has been elevated, or that your HRV has been trending down for weeks.

The advice is based on what you told it, not what actually happened.

And what you tell it is incomplete, subjective, and often wrong.

What if your AI coach could see everything?

We connect your wearables (Garmin, Oura, Whoop, Apple Health, and 50+ other platforms) directly to your AI assistant.

When you open ChatGPT and ask about your training, it already knows:
- Workouts from the past weeks, months, and year
- Sleep quality and patterns
- Heart rate variability and resting heart rate trends
- Daily activity and recovery metrics
- Nutrition and menstrual cycle data (if you track it)

No more context dumps. No more subjective self-reporting.

**How it works**

We use smart compression to turn weeks of wearable data into something an AI can understand and analyze. Instead of dumping raw heart rate readings into a chat window, we surface the trends and patterns that matter—elevated resting HR, declining HRV, increasing training load, poor sleep consistency.

The data rolls up from days to weeks to months to years, so you can spot trends.

And because it's integrated into ChatGPT, you just start chatting.

Beyond wearable data, you can add notes like workout goals, feedback, and other personal information such as availability and injuries. This way, the AI gets that bit of subjective context it needs to give you the best advice.

**Who this is for**

If you're already wearing a watch or ring, and using AI to help plan your training, whether that's for a marathon, strength program, or general fitness, trainedby.ai makes that experience dramatically better.

**Get started**

The product is free to use.

Connect your wearables, add the integration to your AI assistant, and start chatting.
payload.longDescription:
trainedby.ai 将你的可穿戴设备连接到 ChatGPT，让 AI 教练无需你输入任何内容，就能了解真实训练负荷、睡眠模式和恢复情况。

**当今 AI 健身指导的问题**

人们开始用 ChatGPT 规划马拉松训练、力量训练计划或 HYROX 备赛。这很合理，因为 AI 24/7 全天候可用、非常有耐心，也相当懂行。

但不知为何，效果总是不太理想。

这是因为你必须把所有事情都告诉它。每一次。每一件事。

每段对话都从零开始。你必须详细描述当前水平、近期训练、日程和目标。你把 Garmin 截图粘贴进来，努力回忆上周训练内容、睡眠情况、静息心率是否偏高，或 HRV 是否连续数周走低。

建议依据的是你告诉它的内容，而非实际发生的情况。

而你提供的信息并不完整、带有主观性，而且往往不准确。

如果 AI 教练能了解一切，会怎样？

我们将你的可穿戴设备（Garmin、Oura、Whoop、Apple Health 及其他 50 多个平台）直接连接到 AI 助手。

当你打开 ChatGPT 询问训练情况时，它已经掌握：
- 过去几周、几个月和一年的训练记录
- 睡眠质量和模式
- 心率变异性及静息心率趋势
- 每日活动和恢复指标
- 营养和月经周期数据（如果你有追踪）

无需再倾倒一大堆背景信息，也不用再主观地自我报告。

**工作原理**

我们利用智能压缩，将数周的可穿戴设备数据转化为 AI 能够理解和分析的内容。我们不会把原始心率读数一股脑塞进聊天窗口，而是提取重要趋势和模式——静息心率升高、HRV 下降、训练负荷增加、睡眠规律性变差。

数据会从天汇总到周、月、年，让你发现趋势。

它集成在 ChatGPT 中，因此你只需开始聊天。

除可穿戴设备数据外，你还可以添加训练目标、反馈以及可用时间、伤病等个人信息。这样，AI 就能获得提供最佳建议所需的主观背景。

**适用人群**

如果你已经在佩戴手表或戒指，并使用 AI 辅助规划马拉松、力量训练计划或一般健身训练，trainedby.ai 会显著改善这种体验。

**开始使用**

产品可免费使用。

连接可穿戴设备，将集成添加到 AI 助手，然后开始聊天。

payload.name: amp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
amp makes every workout feel intentional, personal, and effortless.

With amp, you can generate a complete workout in seconds—designed around your time, goals, fitness level, available equipment, and focus areas. Whether you’re in the mood for a quick HIIT session, strength training, or a balanced full-body workout, amp removes the planning and delivers a routine that’s ready to go.

Built with input from world-class trainers and powered by intelligent technology, amp adapts workouts to feel structured, balanced, and achievable. Exercises are thoughtfully selected and paced so you know exactly what to do and how long to do it—no guesswork, no endless scrolling.

amp works seamlessly alongside the amp ecosystem, helping you train with purpose at home or in the gym. Let amp guide the session, or adjust on the fly to match your energy and mindset. Every workout is designed to help you stay consistent, focused, and confident in your training.

Just open amp, generate your workout, and start moving.
payload.longDescription:
amp 让每次锻炼都有明确目的、贴合个人需求且轻松开展。

使用 amp，你可以在几秒内生成完整锻炼方案，根据时间、目标、体能水平、可用器材和重点部位设计。无论你想进行简短的 HIIT 训练、力量训练，还是均衡的全身锻炼，amp 都能省去规划，提供可直接开始的方案。

amp 融合世界级教练的建议，由智能技术驱动，调整锻炼内容，使其结构清晰、均衡且可实现。动作经过精心挑选并安排节奏，让你准确知道该做什么、做多久，无需猜测，也无需无休止地滚动浏览。

amp 与 amp 生态系统无缝协作，帮助你在家或健身房有目的地训练。可以让 amp 引导训练，也可以随时根据精力和心态调整。每次锻炼都旨在帮助你坚持训练、保持专注，并对训练充满信心。

只需打开 amp，生成锻炼方案，开始运动。

payload.name: Aiva
payload.description: 赋予临床医护人员超能力
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Aiva helps clinicians get things done on ChatGPT for Healthcare! Give your clinicians real-time voice control over every IT enterprise system in your hospitals including: - Work orders in ServiceNow: Submit an IT Service Management ticket the moment you see a problem, speeding resolution - Policies & Procedures in Wolters Kluwer and Elsevier: Look up proprietary and licensed content real-time, improving utilization and outcomes. - EHRs like Epic and Oracle Cerner: Voice chart across multiple rows and flowsheets in a single command, reducing latency, improving compliance, decreasing incidental overtime and increasing staff and patient satisfaction scores. Lookup vitals, labs and other information from the EHR in real-time. - Dietary like CBORD and Computrition: Give nurses immediate access to all the dietary order information they need without having to place calls or go hunting for information, improving service while reducing distractions. - Messaging tools like Vocera, Voalte and TigerConnect: Send messages to colleagues without having to open up different apps, facilitating communication across the hospital - Smart Patient Rooms built with Siemens, Johnson Controls, Trane, Schneider Electric: Smart devices like lights, blinds, thermostats and TVs, freeing up more time for higher-value direct care. - Patient experience via GetWell, Sonifi, pCare, Vibe, Aceso: Clinicians can play programming for patients like educational videos and meal information. Aiva clients have reported ROI metrics at the AHA, AMIA and AONL: - Improve documentation timeliness by 90% - Reduce incidental nurse overtime by 50% - Increase Press Ganey scores on nursing-sensitive questions up to 37% View a presentation by Cedars-Sinai nurse leaders to the American Medical Informatics Association (AMIA):

https://amia.org/education-events/education-catalog/25x5-webinar-series-reducing-burden-elevating-care-lessons

Aiva benefits for key stakeholders: A secure, HIPAA-compliant platform using API connections and ChatGPT for Healthcare as the single, conversational UI for your entire enterprise technology stack, improving utilization and effectiveness of all your systems. Clinical: An always-on assistant that eliminates all of the interfaces of the systems that detract from direct patient care. Informatics: Proven improvements in documentation latency and compliance while reducing administrative burden. Corporate: Bottom line improvement from reductions in overtime, staff turnover and documentation compliance.
payload.longDescription:
Aiva 帮助临床医护人员在 ChatGPT for Healthcare 中完成工作！ 让临床医护人员实时通过语音控制医院中的每一个企业 IT 系统，包括： - ServiceNow 中的工单：发现问题时立即提交 IT 服务管理工单，加快问题解决。 - Wolters Kluwer 和 Elsevier 中的政策与流程：实时查询专有和授权内容，提高利用率和成效。 - Epic 和 Oracle Cerner 等 EHR：用一条指令，通过语音在多个记录行和流程表中填写病历，减少延迟、提高合规性、减少临时加班，并提高员工和患者满意度评分。实时查询 EHR 中的生命体征、化验结果和其他信息。 - CBORD 和 Computrition 等膳食系统：让护士立即获取所需的全部膳食医嘱信息，无需打电话或四处查找，在减少干扰的同时改善服务。 - Vocera、Voalte 和 TigerConnect 等消息工具：无需打开不同应用即可向同事发送消息，促进全院沟通。 - 采用 Siemens、Johnson Controls、Trane、Schneider Electric 构建的智能病房：控制灯光、百叶窗、恒温器和电视等智能设备，腾出更多时间开展价值更高的直接护理。 - 通过 GetWell、Sonifi、pCare、Vibe、Aceso 改善患者体验：临床医护人员可为患者播放教育视频、餐食信息等内容。 Aiva 客户曾在 AHA、AMIA 和 AONL 报告以下投资回报指标： - 文档记录及时性提高 90% - 护士临时加班减少 50% - Press Ganey 中与护理敏感问题相关的评分提高最多 37% 观看 Cedars-Sinai 护理领导向 American Medical Informatics Association（AMIA）所作的演示：

https://amia.org/education-events/education-catalog/25x5-webinar-series-reducing-burden-elevating-care-lessons

Aiva 为主要利益相关方带来的益处： 一个安全、符合 HIPAA 的平台，采用 API 连接，并以 ChatGPT for Healthcare 作为整个企业技术体系的统一对话界面，提高所有系统的利用率和效能。 临床：始终在线的助手，免去操作那些妨碍直接患者护理的系统界面。 信息学：在减少行政负担的同时，已证实能改善文档记录延迟和合规性。 企业：通过减少加班、员工流失和文档合规问题，改善经营收益。

payload.name: BurnWeek
payload.description: 记录餐食并跟踪卡路里
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BurnWeek is an AI calorie tracker that meets you where you already are. Just say what you ate - "a flat white and a chocolate croissant," "chicken burrito bowl" - and BurnWeek estimates the calories and protein for you and adds it to your day. Because food is never exact, BurnWeek shows honest ranges (e.g. "680-780 cal") instead of fake-precise numbers.

Ask how your day is going and BurnWeek shows what you've eaten and how much you have left. BurnWeek also tracks a 7-day sliding-window budget, so one big day doesn't mean failure - you just balance it out over the week. Made a mistake? Say "undo that." Got the portion wrong? "Make the rice 200 grams" and the estimate recomputes. You can also save recipes and favorites, set up recurring meals, log from a photo or a barcode, and plan meals ahead.

BurnWeek logs to your own private account. Connect your existing BurnWeek app history with a one-time link code so your meals stay in sync between the app and ChatGPT. BurnWeek is general-wellness software, not medical advice, and it never collects payment, location, or health-record data.
payload.longDescription:
BurnWeek 是一款 AI 卡路里追踪器，配合您已有的生活方式使用。只需说出吃了什么——“一杯馥芮白和巧克力羊角面包”“鸡肉墨西哥碗”——BurnWeek 就会估算卡路里和蛋白质并加入当天记录。食物永远无法精确计算，因此 BurnWeek 显示诚实的范围（例如“680–780 千卡”），而不是虚假的精确数字。

询问当天情况，BurnWeek 会显示您吃了什么以及还剩多少。它还跟踪 7 天滚动预算，因此某一天超量不代表失败，只需在一周内平衡即可。记错了？说“撤销”。分量不对？说“把米饭改成 200 克”，估算就会重新计算。您还可以保存食谱和收藏、设置循环餐食、从照片或条形码记录，并提前规划餐食。

BurnWeek 将记录保存到您的私人账户。使用一次性链接代码连接现有 BurnWeek 应用历史，让餐食在应用和 ChatGPT 之间保持同步。BurnWeek 是一般健康软件，不提供医疗建议，也不会收集付款、位置或健康档案数据。

payload.name: GymLog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GymLog connects ChatGPT to your private strength-training history. Review workout summaries, track exercise progress, browse templates, and create confirmed private templates. With a separate privacy grant in the GymLog iOS app, GymLog can also summarize selected Apple Health and Fitness records. Nutrition and body-composition measurements are queued only after explicit confirmation and must be reviewed and approved again on iPhone before being written to Apple Health. GymLog does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment advice.
payload.longDescription: GymLog 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的私人力量训练记录。查看训练摘要、追踪运动进展、浏览模板，并创建需确认的私人模板。在 GymLog iOS 应用中另行授予隐私权限后，GymLog 还可汇总你选定的 Apple Health 和 Fitness 记录。营养和身体成分测量数据只有在明确确认后才会进入待处理队列；写入 Apple Health 前，还必须在 iPhone 上再次审核并批准。GymLog 不提供医疗诊断或治疗建议。

payload.name: Simple Muscle
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI-native workout tracking with Simple Muscle lets ChatGPT read workout plans, explain exercises, create or edit routines, and summarize training history for a signed-in user.
payload.longDescription: Simple Muscle 的 AI 原生训练追踪功能可让 ChatGPT 为已登录用户读取训练计划、讲解动作、创建或编辑训练安排，并总结训练历史。

payload.name: Vertical
payload.summaryOriginal: Train and sync to your watch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Stop pasting screenshots of your runs into ChatGPT. Vertical syncs directly with Garmin, COROS, Polar, Suunto, WHOOP, and Oura, so ChatGPT already knows your training load, thresholds, and recovery before you ask.

Ground ChatGPT by giving it access to 500+ peer-reviewed sports-science papers and the same physiological models — critical-power zones, thresholds, fitness/fatigue tracking and more — coaches use. Build or adjust your training plan in chat, and sync the workouts straight to your watch.
payload.longDescription:
无需再把跑步截图粘贴到 ChatGPT。Vertical 可直接与 Garmin、COROS、Polar、Suunto、WHOOP 和 Oura 同步，因此你提问前，ChatGPT 就已了解你的训练负荷、阈值和恢复情况。

为 ChatGPT 提供 500+ 篇经同行评审的运动科学论文以及教练使用的相同生理模型作为依据，包括临界功率区间、阈值、体能/疲劳跟踪等。直接在聊天中制定或调整训练计划，并将训练内容同步到手表。

payload.name: Do Workout
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Do Workout account to ChatGPT to review your training, understand your progress, check your schedule and programs, and get practical suggestions based on your workout history. You can also create program change proposals for review in Do Workout. Changes are applied only after you explicitly accept them.
payload.longDescription: 将 Do Workout 账户连接到 ChatGPT，即可查看训练情况、了解进步、检查日程和训练计划，并根据锻炼历史获得实用建议。你还可以创建训练计划变更提案，并在 Do Workout 中审阅。只有在你明确接受后，变更才会生效。

payload.name: PlateLens
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring PlateLens—an AI-powered calorie and nutrition tracker—into ChatGPT. Ask about the data you already log: review calories, macros, micronutrients, and ingredients; understand your estimated calorie deficit or surplus against your plan; summarize hydration and activity; follow weight changes against your goals; and review recorded glucose readings with their measurement times and provenance when you grant the separate glucose permission. The integration is read-only and cannot create, edit, or delete PlateLens data. Results reflect estimates and synced observations in your account, not diagnoses, treatment advice, or medication recommendations.
payload.longDescription: 将 AI 卡路里与营养追踪器 PlateLens 引入 ChatGPT。询问您已记录的数据：查看卡路里、宏量营养素、微量营养素和食材；根据计划了解估算的热量缺口或盈余；汇总饮水和活动情况；根据目标追踪体重变化；在您授予单独的血糖权限后，还可查看记录的血糖读数及其测量时间和来源。此集成为只读，无法创建、编辑或删除 PlateLens 数据。结果反映您账户中的估算值和同步观测数据，不构成诊断、治疗建议或用药建议。

payload.name: 84asana
payload.description: 面向初学者的古典瑜伽
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
84asana is a free classical yoga guide for beginners.

• 13 foundational asanas with step-by-step instructions, benefits, and contraindications
• Complete warm-up sequence — Arrival & Centering, 15 Joint Rotations, and Surya Namaskar
• 40-minute Dhyana meditation practice with breath awareness and Brumadhyam focus
• No login, no account, no payment — completely free

Ask anything: "Show me Tree Pose", "Take me through the warm-up", or "Guide me through meditation".
payload.longDescription:
84asana 是为初学者提供的免费古典瑜伽指南。

• 13 个基础体式，包含逐步指导、益处和禁忌
• 完整热身流程——安顿与静心、15 项关节转动和 Surya Namaskar（拜日式）
• 40 分钟 Dhyana 冥想练习，包含呼吸觉察和 Brumadhyam 眉心专注
• 无需登录、账户或付款——完全免费

随时提问：“给我看看树式”“带我完成热身”或“引导我冥想”。

payload.name: Health Memory
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Health memory helps you save and manage personal health notes directly through ChatGPT. You can create topics, organize information, and keep track of things like symptoms, medications, and questions for your doctor—all in one place.

Simply tell ChatGPT what you want to save, and it will securely store it in your health memory account on Triangle Health. You can also ask to retrieve or update your notes whenever you need them.

Health memory is designed with privacy and control in mind. You decide what information is shared, and all actions are performed only with your explicit permission.

This app is intended solely for personal note-taking and organization. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment recommendations.
payload.longDescription:
Health Memory 帮助你直接通过 ChatGPT 保存和管理个人健康笔记。你可以创建主题、整理信息，并在一处记录症状、药物以及要咨询医生的问题等内容。

只需告诉 ChatGPT 想保存什么，信息便会安全地存入你在 Triangle Health 的健康记忆账号。需要时也可要求检索或更新笔记。

Health Memory 注重隐私和控制权。你可以决定分享哪些信息，所有操作都只会在获得你明确许可后执行。

此应用仅用于个人记录和整理，不提供医疗建议、诊断或治疗建议。

payload.name: Joti
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Joti is a workout tracking app for planning, scheduling, and logging strength, bodyweight, flexibility, and cardio training. This connector lets ChatGPT read a user's own workouts, completed workout history, aggregated stats (volume, consistency, personal bests, top lifts), and the shared exercise library (roughly 800 exercises plus the user's own custom ones), and to schedule workouts onto the user's calendar. Writes are additive only: create a brand-new workout, duplicate an existing one, and fully manage scheduled-workout calendar entries. It cannot edit or delete an existing workout's exercises/sets, and cannot start, log, or alter a session — those stay in the Joti app. Body measurements and progress photos are out of scope entirely. Reads are scoped to data the user owns outright; every write is undoable in Joti's Activity feed.
payload.longDescription: Joti 是一款训练记录应用，用于规划、安排和记录力量、自重、柔韧性及有氧训练。此连接器让 ChatGPT 读取用户自己的训练计划、已完成训练的历史记录、汇总统计（训练量、坚持情况、个人最佳成绩、表现最佳的力量动作）及共享动作库（约 800 个动作，加上用户自定义的动作），并将训练安排到用户日历中。训练计划写入仅支持新增：创建全新的训练计划或复制已有计划；同时可全面管理日历中的已安排训练条目。它不能编辑或删除已有训练计划的动作或组数，也不能开始、记录或修改一次实际训练，这些操作仍需在 Joti 应用中完成。身体测量数据和进度照片完全不在访问范围内。读取仅限于用户本人拥有的数据；每次写入都可在 Joti 的 Activity 动态记录中撤销。

payload.name: Atlante Clinico
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Atlante’s published psychotherapy repertoire by topic, title, author or orientation. Choose a technique to open its procedure, cautions and sources. Connect your existing verified Atlante account; its access allowances apply. Connection screens support English and Italian. Publications retain their source language; translations generated by your assistant are identified separately. Use general topic queries without patient identifiers.
payload.longDescription: 按主题、标题、作者或流派搜索 Atlante 已发布的心理治疗方法库。选择一种技术，打开其操作流程、注意事项和来源。连接现有且已验证的 Atlante 账户，其访问额度仍适用。连接界面支持英语和意大利语。出版内容保留原始语言；助手生成的译文会单独标识。请使用一般性主题查询，不包含患者身份标识。

payload.name: Reframe: Drink Less Alcohol
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Reframe is the #1 alcohol reduction app, built to help you drink less and live more. Whether your goal is to cut back or quit drinking entirely, Reframe's neuroscience approach can help you change the way alcohol shows up in your life.

With a core 160-day, evidence-based, education program, progress tracking, world's largest private community of people cutting back, and a multitude of tools (think meditations, games, and more!), you've got everything you need to change your relationship with booze at the click of a button
payload.longDescription:
Reframe 是 #1 减少饮酒应用，旨在帮助你少喝酒、享受更多生活。无论你的目标是减少饮酒还是完全戒酒，Reframe 的神经科学方法都能帮助你改变酒精在生活中的影响。

该应用包含核心的 160 天循证教育计划、进度跟踪、全球最大的戒酒或减酒者私人社群，以及多种工具（例如冥想、游戏等）。只需轻点按钮，你就拥有改变自己与酒精关系所需的一切。

payload.name: Volm
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan your training with ChatGPT and take it to the gym with Volm. Keep your workouts, programs, and training history in one place, giving ChatGPT the context to help you build a plan around your goals and schedule. Follow your workouts set by set in the Volm app, then review your progress with ChatGPT and adjust what comes next. Connect your Volm account for free.
payload.longDescription: 通过 ChatGPT 规划训练，并将计划带到健身房。使用 Volm 将训练内容、训练计划和训练记录集中管理，让 ChatGPT 根据你的目标和日程提供规划建议。在 Volm 应用中逐组跟练，然后通过 ChatGPT 查看进展并调整后续安排。免费连接 Volm 账户。

payload.name: PAWFECT | PUPPY YOGA
payload.description: 预订附近的幼犬瑜伽活动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Stretch, create, and cuddle! Pawfect Max combines relaxing yoga and guided painting with the playful joy of puppies. Wellness meets wagging tails in this fun, feel-good workshop.
payload.longDescription: 伸展、创作、拥抱！Pawfect Max 将放松瑜伽和引导绘画与幼犬的活泼乐趣结合起来。在这场有趣又令人愉悦的工作坊中，健康体验遇上摇摆的尾巴。

payload.name: TRAINEDBY
payload.description: 依据已验证记录辅导客户
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TRAINEDBY lets an authenticated coach use ChatGPT with the clients currently on that coach’s roster. It can read workouts, meals, check-ins, body progress and supported health evidence; investigate patterns; and prepare precise workout or nutrition drafts. External AI cannot publish plan-affecting changes: the coach reviews and applies them inside TRAINEDBY.
payload.longDescription: TRAINEDBY 允许已通过身份验证的教练在 ChatGPT 中使用目前列于该教练名下的客户数据。它可以读取训练、饮食、签到、身体进度和受支持的健康证据；调查规律；并准备精确的训练或营养计划草稿。外部 AI 无法发布会影响计划的更改：教练需在 TRAINEDBY 中审核并应用这些更改。

payload.name: 今天训练
payload.description: 健身训练记录与身体趋势分析
payload.summaryOriginal: 健身训练记录与身体趋势分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: “今天训练”是面向个人健身的训练记录分析插件。连接后，ChatGPT 可查询你在今天训练 App 中已保存并同步的训练记录、每组数据、动作历史和当前计划，帮助复盘训练及比较动作进步。经你单独授权，还可结合身体记录、Apple 健康中的健身与恢复汇总、补剂记录、进度照片、训练路线和已保存的 AI 建议进行分析。插件只读取已授权的档案，不修改或删除记录，不读取未保存的训练草稿。它用于日常健身参考，不提供医疗诊断或治疗。
payload.longDescription: “今天训练”是面向个人健身的训练记录分析插件。连接后，ChatGPT 可查询你在今天训练 App 中已保存并同步的训练记录、每组数据、动作历史和当前计划，帮助复盘训练及比较动作进步。经你单独授权，还可结合身体记录、Apple 健康中的健身与恢复汇总、补剂记录、进度照片、训练路线和已保存的 AI 建议进行分析。插件只读取已授权的档案，不修改或删除记录，不读取未保存的训练草稿。它用于日常健身参考，不提供医疗诊断或治疗。

payload.name: STREEQ
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中查看个人健身记录
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: STREEQ gives an individual controlled access to their own fitness record from ChatGPT. It can read workout, food, body-progress and supported health history; log evidence; and manage the person’s workout programme or nutrition strategy when they own that plan. If an active TRAINEDBY coach owns a plan, STREEQ blocks self-directed plan changes.
payload.longDescription: STREEQ 让个人能够通过 ChatGPT 受控地访问自己的健身记录。它可以读取锻炼、饮食、身体进展和支持的健康历史；记录相关证据；并在用户拥有相应计划时管理其锻炼计划或营养策略。如果某项计划由正在合作的 TRAINEDBY 教练所有，STREEQ 会阻止用户自行更改计划。

payload.name: Health
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中探索健康数据
payload.summaryOriginal: Explore your health data in ChatGPT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect supported medical records and Apple Health data to ground ChatGPT conversations in your health information, understand results in context, and follow changes in labs, sleep, and activity over time.
payload.longDescription: 连接受支持的医疗记录及 Apple Health 数据，让 ChatGPT 对话以你的健康信息为依据，结合背景理解结果，并长期跟踪化验、睡眠及活动的变化。

payload.name: rit.run
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: rit.run Coach helps authenticated rit.run users review safe profile, workout, weekly training, heart-rate, and running shoe summaries from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: rit.run Coach 帮助已通过身份验证的 rit.run 用户在 ChatGPT 中查看安全的个人资料、锻炼、每周训练、心率和跑鞋摘要。

payload.name: Stedi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Run real-time patient health insurance eligibility checks across 1,250+ payers using natural language. Get a patient’s coverage details, deductibles, copays, and benefits in seconds. Built-in guidance helps you troubleshoot failed checks, interpret eligibility errors, and resolve common issues quickly.
payload.longDescription: 使用自然语言，对 1,250+ 家付款方进行实时患者健康保险资格核验。几秒钟内即可获取患者的承保详情、免赔额、共付额和福利。内置指南可帮助你排查核验失败、解读资格错误并快速解决常见问题。

payload.name: rit.run
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: rit.run helps connected users review their running activity, heart-rate and pace summaries, running shoes, and active weekly training plan for fitness coaching. Users can compare rit.run runner, shoe, and anonymous route rankings, open privacy-trimmed Google Maps links, request changes to eligible future plan days, and submit training-method or product feedback to rit.run.
payload.longDescription: rit.run 帮助已连接的用户查看跑步活动、心率和配速摘要、跑鞋以及当前每周训练计划，以获得健身指导。用户可以比较 rit.run 跑者、跑鞋和匿名路线排行榜，打开经过隐私处理的 Google Maps 链接，请求调整符合条件的未来计划日，并向 rit.run 提交训练方法或产品反馈。

payload.name: WODone
payload.description: 通过照片记录每日训练
payload.summaryOriginal: Log your WODs from a photo.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
WODone turns the gym whiteboard into a training log you can talk to.

Upload a photo of the day's WOD and ChatGPT reads it, then WODone saves it as a structured record: workout type, movements with reps and loads, your score, and the original text exactly as written. Weights and distances are converted to consistent units, and movement names are normalized, so "T2B", "toes to bar", and "Toes-To-Bar" all land on the same movement in your history.

Ask for your records and WODone shows them newest first, or filters by date or movement — "show my thruster workouts from last week". Open one and you also see how you performed each of its movements before, so you can tell whether today was heavier or faster than last time.

Got something wrong? Tell WODone what to fix and it corrects the record, or delete it.

WODone never receives your photos — ChatGPT reads them and passes along only the text.
payload.longDescription:
WODone将健身房的白板变成可互动的训练记录本

上传当天训练内容的照片，ChatGPT会读取内容，WODone将其保存为结构化记录：训练类型、包含次数和重量的动作信息、你的成绩，以及原始文本的完整呈现。重量和距离会统一转换为标准单位，动作名称会进行标准化处理，因此「T2B」「toes to bar」「Toes-To-Bar」等不同写法都会在历史记录中归为同一动作

查询训练记录时，WODone会按最新优先显示，或根据日期/动作筛选——例如「展示我上周的推举训练」。打开具体记录后，还能查看该训练各动作的过往表现数据，便于对比本次训练是否更重或更快

记录有误吗？告诉WODone需要修改的内容，它会自动修正记录或直接删除

WODone不会保存你的照片——ChatGPT读取后仅传递文本内容

payload.name: Match with Care
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: UK later-life care: types of care, typical costs, council and NHS funding, arranging care, help for unpaid carers, and ways to pay, from trusted sources. Not medical or medication advice. Does not pick a named carer, browse vacancies, or recommend financial products.
payload.longDescription: 英国老年护理：护理类型、典型费用、地方政府和NHS资金、护理安排方式、对非正式照顾者的帮助以及支付方式，信息来源于可信渠道。不提供医疗或药物建议。不指定特定护理人员、浏览职位空缺或推荐金融产品。

payload.name: Foodzilla
payload.description: 规划膳食，管理您的实践
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Foodzilla is the nutrition platform dietitians, nutritionists and health coaches use to plan, track and run their practice. This plugin puts that work in the conversation.

Ask ChatGPT for a recipe and it is written, costed for macros and saved to your library. Ask for a week of meals to a calorie and macro target and you get a template ready to review and assign. Add a food to your own database from a label or a link. Draft an intake form, set your booking hours, publish a post to your clients, or check where your subscription stands.

Your clients can connect too, if you let them. A client asks their own assistant to log a meal, water, a workout, their sleep or their weight, and to read the plan for the day. Everything they log lands in their diary, where their coach already looks.

Your client data is not reachable from your connection. A coach connection cannot see a client list, a client's diary, their notes or their record, and it cannot message anyone. It works on the coach's own material only: recipes, foods, meal plan templates, collections, forms, booking hours, content, the store and the subscription. A client connection reaches that one client's own record and nobody else's, and cannot change the plan or the targets their coach set for them. Names and email addresses never go into our server logs.

You need a Foodzilla account. Foodzilla Autopilot is included with the Professional plan and above. Client access is a switch the coach controls, for one client or for everyone.
payload.longDescription:
Foodzilla是营养师、营养师和健康教练用来规划、追踪并管理其实践的营养平台。此插件将这些工作融入对话中。

向ChatGPT请求食谱，它将自动生成并计算宏量营养素成本，保存至您的资料库。请求符合卡路里和宏量营养素目标的一周膳食计划，您将获得可审核和分配的模板。通过标签或链接将食物添加至您的数据库。撰写初诊表、设置预约时段、向客户发布动态，或查看订阅状态。

您可选择是否允许客户连接。客户可让自己的助手记录膳食、饮水、锻炼、睡眠或体重，并查看当日计划。所有记录内容将进入他们的日记，供教练查阅。

您的客户数据无法通过连接访问。教练连接无法查看客户列表、客户日记、笔记或档案，也无法发送消息。它仅使用教练自身的资料：食谱、食物、膳食计划模板、资料集、表单、预约时段、内容、商店和订阅。客户连接仅能访问对应客户的档案，且无法修改教练设定的计划或目标。姓名和电子邮件地址不会进入我们的服务器日志。

您需要拥有Foodzilla账户。Foodzilla Autopilot包含在专业版及以上计划中。客户访问权限由教练控制，可针对单个客户或全体开启。

payload.name: Skyscanner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Compare and book cheap flights from anywhere, to everywhere. 

We scan all the top airlines and travel providers, so you can compare flight fares and other travel costs in one place. Once you’ve found the best flight, you book directly with the provider.
payload.longDescription:
比较并预订从世界各地出发、前往任意目的地的低价航班。

我们会搜索各大航空公司和旅行服务商，让你在一处比较机票价格和其他旅行费用。找到心仪航班后，你可以直接向服务商预订。

payload.name: FlightPoints
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FlightPoints helps travelers search award availability across airline loyalty programs, compare points prices, filter by cabin and routing preferences, and inspect flight segments. Search cached availability without signing in, or link a FlightPoints account to request live results. FlightPoints can open booking handoff links but does not complete bookings or accept payment.
payload.longDescription: FlightPoints 搜索各航空忠诚度计划的奖励票库存，比较积分价格并按舱位和航线筛选；可匿名搜索缓存或连接账户获取实时结果。可打开预订交接链接，但不完成预订或收款。

payload.name: trivago
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The trivago MCP server lets users search for hotels and other accommodations by travel dates and location, from countries and cities to specific venues, landmarks, or other points of interest. Using the details provided, it returns tailored hotel options with prices from multiple booking sites, plus photos, key accommodation details, and helpful links to learn more. In simple terms, it gives AI assistants an efficient way to help users find the right stay at the right price.

You can use the trivago app for 

Search hotels by destination and dates:
"Find me a hotel in Las Vegas for 2 people from 12 July to 20 July 2026"

Find budget accommodation near landmarks:
"I need a cheap accommodation near the Eiffel Tower for 1 night the 12th of June 2026"

Book hotels near event venues:
"Find me a hotel near the Etihad Stadium for 12 July to 14 July 2026"

Coordinate travel with conferences:
"I need accommodation close to the venue of the next KubeCon happening in Europe in 2026"

Plan family vacations:
"I am searching for 2 rooms for 2 adults and 2 children aged 6 and 10 in Barcelona for Easter 2026"
payload.longDescription:
trivago MCP 服务器允许用户根据旅行日期和地点搜索酒店及其他住宿，范围从国家、城市，到具体场馆、地标或其他兴趣点。它会依据提供的详情返回定制酒店选项和多个预订网站的价格，以及照片、住宿关键信息和实用详情链接。简而言之，它为 AI 助手提供高效方式，帮助用户以合适价格找到合适住宿。

你可以使用 trivago 应用来

按目的地和日期搜索酒店：
“帮我找一家 Las Vegas 的酒店，2 人入住，日期为 2026 年 7 月 12 日至 7 月 20 日”

在地标附近寻找经济型住宿：
“我需要 Eiffel Tower 附近的便宜住宿，住 1 晚，日期是 2026 年 6 月 12 日”

预订活动场馆附近的酒店：
“帮我找一家 Etihad Stadium 附近的酒店，日期为 2026 年 7 月 12 日至 7 月 14 日”

协调会议差旅：
“我需要住在 2026 年于 Europe 举办的下一届 KubeCon 会场附近”

规划家庭假期：
“我想在 2026 年 Easter 期间入住 Barcelona，订 2 间客房，住 2 位成人和 2 位分别为 6 岁和 10 岁的儿童”

payload.name: Turkish Airlines
payload.description: 搭乘 Turkish Airlines 出行
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan and book your Turkish Airlines flights directly in ChatGPT. See real-time flight status, compare fares across cabin classes, and then continue to turkishairlines.com to securely complete your booking. You can also look up existing reservations with your PNR or e-ticket number, check baggage allowances, explore city guides, and browse promotional offers.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中规划并预订 Turkish Airlines 航班。查看实时航班状态，比较不同舱位的票价，然后前往 turkishairlines.com 安全完成预订。你也可以使用 PNR 或电子客票号码查询现有预订、查看行李额度、浏览城市指南和促销优惠。

payload.name: komoot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Komoot helps people discover inspiring outdoor adventures!
Explore routes and community-recommended highlights for cycling, hiking, running, and more, shared by a global community of outdoor enthusiasts.
payload.longDescription:
komoot 帮助人们发现精彩的户外探险！
探索全球户外爱好者社区分享的骑行、徒步、跑步等路线及社区推荐的亮点地点。

payload.name: Trip.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search and compare flights, hotels, trains, attractions directly in ChatGPT with Trip.com, your all-in-one travel companion. Explore one-way, round-trip and multi-city flights; select hotels in your target cities; pick suitable rail journeys across Europe and Asia, also discover attractions, tickets, tours, experiences, and other things to do with flexible search, filtering, and sorting!

Trip.com is perfect for your journey inspiration, itinerary planning, and travel product booking. Enjoy secure instant booking, and 24/7 support with multiple languages.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中直接搜索和比较航班、酒店、火车及景点，Trip.com 是你的全方位旅行助手。探索单程、往返和多城市航班；选择目的地城市的酒店；挑选适合的欧洲和亚洲铁路行程；还可通过灵活的搜索、筛选和排序发现景点、门票、旅行团、体验活动及其他可做的事情！

Trip.com 适合获取旅行灵感、规划行程和预订旅行产品。享受安全即时预订和每周 7 天、每天 24 小时的多语言支持。

payload.name: Flight Network
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Use Flight Network ChatGPT app to find and compare real-time flight options directly in your chat.                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  Simply type @Flight Network followed by your request, or ask for flight recommendations during any travel planning conversation. Example: "Find flights from NYC to London in two weeks"                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  Real-Time Data: Access live pricing and availability from hundreds of airlines instantly.                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
  Conversational Search: No complex filters. Just tell Flight Network ChatGPT app where you want to go and when.
payload.longDescription:
使用 Flight Network 的 ChatGPT 应用，直接在聊天中查找并比较实时航班选项。

只需输入 @Flight Network 并接上你的需求，或在任何旅行规划对话中询问航班建议。例如：“查找两周后从 NYC 飞往 London 的航班。”

实时数据：即时获取数百家航空公司的实时价格和可用情况。

对话式搜索：无需复杂筛选条件。只需告诉 Flight Network ChatGPT 应用你想去哪里、何时出发。

payload.name: AnyWhereMap - Navigate+Locate
payload.description: 查找和探索地点与位置
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A fantastic way to use maps with ChatGPT!

Ask it to display the map for somewhere, then scroll and zoom around. Discuss the visible area with ChatGPT, drop pins, and ask questions.

e.g. 

- "Open an interactive @AnyWhereMap"
- "Show me New York City in an interactive @AnyWhereMap"

Open the map, scroll to an area and ask:

- "What is in this area?"
- "Is this a nice place to visit?"
payload.longDescription:
与 ChatGPT 一起使用地图的精彩方式！

请它显示某个地方的地图，然后滚动并缩放。与 ChatGPT 讨论可见区域、放置标记并提问。

例如：

- “打开交互式 @AnyWhereMap”
- “在交互式 @AnyWhereMap 中显示纽约市”

打开地图，滚动到某个区域，然后问：

- “这个区域有什么？”
- “这里适合游玩吗？”

payload.name: Expedia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan your next trip with Expedia, right inside ChatGPT — an easy way to research and compare travel in everyday language. Ask for flights or hotels and see real-time prices, availability, and photos in the conversation. You can now link your Expedia account in ChatGPT to unlock member deals and personalized recommendations.
• Search flights and hotels worldwide
• Compare prices and view hotels on a map
• Explore destinations and plan where to stay
When you're ready, continue on Expedia to book and earn One Key rewards.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中使用 Expedia 规划下一次旅行——用日常语言研究和比较旅行选项，轻松方便。询问航班或酒店，即可在对话中查看实时价格、空房情况和照片。现在还可以在 ChatGPT 中关联 Expedia 账户，获取会员优惠和个性化推荐。
• 搜索全球航班和酒店
• 比较价格并在地图上查看酒店
• 探索目的地并规划住宿地点
准备好后，可前往 Expedia 继续预订并赚取 One Key 奖励。

payload.name: Booking.com
payload.summaryOriginal: Find all best stays and more.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore millions of stays, unforgettable attractions and find the ideal rental car for your next getaway, directly with Booking.com on ChatGPT.

- Discover hotels, homes, and everything in between.
- Get great cars at great prices.
- Find must-see attractions and experiences.

Something caught your eye? Tap "View on Booking.com" to book your stay, rental car or attraction today.
payload.longDescription:
直接通过ChatGPT中的Booking.com探索数百万个住宿选项和令人难忘的景点，并为下一次度假找到理想的租赁汽车。

- 探索酒店、住宅和各类住宿。
- 以优惠价格租到优质汽车。
- 查找必看景点和体验。

看到心仪的选项？点击“在Booking.com上查看”，立即预订住宿、租赁汽车或景点。

payload.name: Wikiloc
payload.description: 只需开口，找到理想路线
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Describe where you want to go and what you want to do, and skip the search. Get a tailored selection of trails from Wikiloc's 77 million authentic trails, shared by 20 million outdoor enthusiasts worldwide.

Ask for hiking routes near your destination, cycling paths that match your fitness level, or hidden trails locals love. Explore interactive trail maps with waypoints marking peaks, waterfalls, viewpoints, and other highlights mapped by the Wikiloc community. 

See over 140 million photos taken along the trails so you know what awaits before you plan your next adventure.

Try asking:

- "Find me family-friendly trails in Spain"
- "Show me mountain bike routes in the Alps around 20km"
- "I'm visiting Italy next week. Find me 3 beautiful hikes near the Dolomites with lake views"
- "I want to see the great cliffs of Ireland. Recommend me some hikes"
- "Show me some stunning hikes ideal for a weekend in California"
payload.longDescription:
描述你想去哪里以及想做什么，无需再费力搜索。你可以从 Wikiloc 的 77 million 条真实路线中获得量身定制的精选路线；这些路线由全球 20 million 名户外爱好者分享。

询问目的地附近的徒步路线、符合你体能水平的骑行路线，或当地人喜爱的隐秘小径。探索互动路线地图，查看 Wikiloc 社区标注的山峰、瀑布、观景点和其他亮点。

查看沿途拍摄的 140 million 多张照片，提前了解景色，为下一次探险做好计划。

可以试着询问：

- “帮我找西班牙适合家庭的路线”
- “给我看看阿尔卑斯山附近约 20km 的山地自行车路线”
- “我下周要去意大利。帮我找多洛米蒂附近 3 条可以欣赏湖景的优美徒步路线”
- “我想看看爱尔兰壮观的悬崖。给我推荐几条徒步路线”
- “给我推荐一些适合在加利福尼亚度过周末的绝美徒步路线”

payload.name: MakeMyTrip
payload.description: 查找航班、酒店和出租车
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover flights, hotels and cabs with real time inventory and pricing right inside your conversation.
payload.longDescription: 在对话中直接查询实时库存和价格，发现航班、酒店和出租车。

payload.name: Travel 101: Trip Itineraries
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Travel 101 helps you plan trips by turning your preferences into full itineraries. Get a day-by-day plan with flights, accommodation, activities, budget, maps, and more. Save and edit your itinerary in Scratchpad, and share it with travel buddies. No forms or rigid templates, just describe your vibe and get a ready-to-use plan.
payload.longDescription: Travel 101 根据你的偏好制定完整行程，帮助你规划旅行。获取包含航班、住宿、活动、预算、地图等内容的逐日计划。在 Scratchpad 中保存和编辑行程，并与旅伴分享。无需填写表单或套用僵化模板，只要描述你想要的旅行风格，就能获得可直接使用的计划。

payload.name: TABLEALL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TABLEALL helps travelers and diners discover and reserve fine dining restaurants across Japan through ChatGPT. Users can search by region, area, or cuisine, check real-time availability, view course menus and pricing, review cancellation policies, and create reservations or reservation requests.

TABLEALL supports Michelin-starred restaurants and a wide range of cuisines including sushi, kaiseki, tempura, wagyu, French, Italian, and more. Payments are completed securely on TableAll's website after a payment link is returned.
payload.longDescription:
TABLEALL 通过 ChatGPT 帮助旅行者和食客在日本各地发现并预订高级餐厅。用户可以按地区、区域或菜系搜索，查看实时空位、套餐菜单和价格、取消政策，并创建预订或预订请求。

TABLEALL 支持米其林星级餐厅以及多种菜系，包括寿司、怀石料理、天妇罗、和牛、法国菜、意大利菜等。返回付款链接后，可在 TableAll 网站上安全完成付款。

payload.name: Gondola
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gondola helps users search hotels, flights, and rental cars, compare rates and loyalty value, review trip details, manage rate alerts, and complete supported hotel or rental car bookings through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Gondola 帮助用户搜索酒店、航班和租车，比较价格和忠诚度权益，查看行程详情，管理价格提醒，并通过 ChatGPT 完成支持的酒店或租车预订。

payload.name: ForeFlight Mobile
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your ForeFlight data, in conversation. Ask for weather, NOTAMs, and forecasts for any airport. Get route and altitude recommendations with real performance data. Review or log flights, check currency, and manage your logbook - all through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 在对话中使用你的 ForeFlight 数据。查询任意机场的天气、NOTAM 航行通告和预报。获取基于真实性能数据的航线和高度建议。通过 ChatGPT 查看或记录飞行、检查飞行资质有效状态并管理飞行日志。

payload.name: eDreams
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Skip the hassle of comparing dozens of tabs. eDreams helps you search and compare flights and hotels in one place, but through a simple conversation.
Just tell it where and when you want to travel, and it quickly shows the cheapest and best options so you can decide faster.
payload.longDescription:
无需再为比较几十个标签页而烦恼。eDreams 让你通过简单对话，在一个地方搜索和比较航班与酒店。
只需告诉它你想去哪里、何时出发，它就会迅速展示最便宜且合适的选项，帮助你更快做出决定。

payload.name: Kiwi.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search for flights with flexible options around dates, nearby airports, baggage, and stops. 
Discover cheaper routes through virtual interlining (combining flights from different airlines that don't normally connect).
Explore destinations with "anywhere" searches or browse multiple options on an interactive map.
Get full itineraries with pricing, schedules, and booking links - all within the chat.
payload.longDescription:
搜索航班时可灵活调整日期、附近机场、行李和中途停留选项。
通过虚拟联程（组合通常不会衔接的不同航空公司航班）探索更便宜的路线。
使用“任意地点”搜索探索目的地，或在交互式地图上浏览多个选项。
直接在聊天中获取完整行程、价格、时刻表和预订链接。

payload.name: Wego
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Wego helps you find the best prices for flights and hotels inside ChatGPT. We search across 700+ travel websites to surface accurate, highly competitive rates—then show them in a beautiful, clean, easy-to-understand interface.

Compare and refine results with the filters you expect. For flights, filter by airline, departure time, and other essentials to quickly find the right itinerary. For hotels, narrow options by property type, star rating, location, price range, and amenities so you can find the right stay faster.

Trusted by 83M+ travelers worldwide, Wego is top-rated with a 4.7 rating on the iOS App Store and 4.5 on Google Play. Need help? Our 24/7 support connects you with a real person.
payload.longDescription:
Wego 帮助你在 ChatGPT 中找到价格优惠的机票和酒店。我们会搜索 700+ 个旅游网站，提供准确且极具竞争力的价格，并通过清晰、美观、易懂的界面展示结果。

使用常见筛选条件比较并细化结果。查找航班时，可按航空公司、出发时间及其他重要条件筛选，快速找到合适的行程。查找酒店时，可按住宿类型、星级、位置、价格范围和设施缩小选择范围，更快找到合适的住宿。

全球有 83M+ 旅行者信赖 Wego；它在 iOS App Store 上获得 4.7 评分，在 Google Play 上获得 4.5 评分。需要帮助？我们的 24/7 支持服务会为你接通真人客服。

payload.name: Ryanair
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find and book Ryanair flights faster with a conversational interface. Simply tell the assistant where you want to go and when — it will search available routes, show you flight options with prices, and guide you directly to the Ryanair website to complete your booking.

**What you can do:**
- Search for destinations,  one-way or return flights by destination and date
- Browse available flights with fare information
- Get redirected to Ryanair's website to finalise your booking securely

No more clicking through multiple pages to find what you need. Just describe your trip and get straight to the relevant results.

*Booking and payment are completed directly on Ryanair.com. This assistant helps you find and select flights — it does not process payments or store personal data.*
payload.longDescription:
通过对话界面，更快查找并预订瑞安航空航班。只需告诉助手你想去哪里、何时出发，它就会搜索可用航线、显示带价格的航班选项，并直接引导你前往瑞安航空网站完成预订。

**你可以：**
- 按目的地和日期搜索目的地、单程或往返航班
- 浏览可用航班及票价信息
- 跳转到瑞安航空网站，安全完成预订

无需再逐页点击查找所需信息。只需描述行程，即可直接查看相关结果。

*预订和付款均直接在 Ryanair.com 完成。此助手帮助你查找和选择航班，不处理付款，也不存储个人数据。*

payload.name: World Airfares
payload.description: 搜索航班，点击即可预订
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
World Airfares Flight Search brings real-time flight search directly into your ChatGPT conversation. Simply tell ChatGPT where and when you want to fly, and get instant results from a live flight inventory - no app switching, no tab juggling.

Browse results by recommended picks, airline, or all available options. Filter by travel dates, cabin class, and passengers. Each result shows full flight details including stops, duration, baggage, and pricing. When you're ready, tap Book Now to go straight to the booking page.

Built on the World Airfares API, this app covers one-way, round-trip, and multi-city itineraries across hundreds of airlines worldwide.
payload.longDescription:
World Airfares Flight Search 将实时航班搜索直接带入 ChatGPT 对话。只需告诉 ChatGPT 目的地和出行时间，即可从实时航班库存中获得即时结果，无需切换应用或来回打开标签页。

可按推荐选项、航空公司或所有可用选项浏览结果，并按出行日期、舱位和乘客人数筛选。每项结果都会显示完整航班详情，包括经停、时长、行李和价格。准备好后，点击“立即预订”即可前往预订页面。

该应用基于 World Airfares API，可搜索全球数百家航空公司的单程、往返和多城市行程。

payload.name: Bolt
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bolt Rides helps riders compare current or scheduled ride estimates, and open Bolt to complete their booking.
payload.longDescription: Bolt Rides 帮助乘客比较即时或预约行程的预估费用，并打开 Bolt 完成预订。

payload.name: GuruWalk: Tours & Activities
payload.description: 查找并预订旅行团与门票
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore any city with GuruWalk, the world's largest free walking tour platform. On a free tour you join at no upfront cost and pay the guide whatever you think the experience was worth at the end. GuruWalk also offers guided visits, day trips and skip-the-line tickets in more than 1,000 cities, from Madrid and Rome to Tokyo, Buenos Aires and New York.

Just say where you're going and when. Each tour comes with its photo, real traveller ratings, the language it's run in, how long it lasts and the times still available for your dates, so you can compare options in one place.

GuruWalk doesn't charge you or complete the booking here. It takes you straight to the tour page on guruwalk.com to finish there, and it can answer the practical questions first: how cancellation works, where the meeting point is, or how to book for a group, using GuruWalk's official support guides.
payload.longDescription:
通过 GuruWalk 探索任意城市。这是全球最大的免费步行游平台。参加免费团无需预先付费，结束时可按自己认为的体验价值向导付费。GuruWalk 还在 1,000 多座城市提供导览、一日游和免排队门票，覆盖马德里、罗马、东京、布宜诺斯艾利斯和纽约等地。

只需说明目的地和出行时间。每个行程都附有照片、真实旅客评分、讲解语言、时长，以及所选日期仍可参加的时段，方便你集中比较。

GuruWalk 不会在此向你收费或完成预订，而会直接带你前往 guruwalk.com 的行程页面完成预订。你也可以先根据 GuruWalk 官方支持指南了解实用信息，例如取消规则、集合地点或团体预订方式。
